DOP: abhisallekhika ( and ābhisallekhika), mfn. [abhisallekha + ika], concerned with austerity, with strict abstinence ; M III 113, 25 (kathā ~ā cetovivaraṇasappāyā … seyyathīdaṃ appicchakathā santuṭṭhikathā pavekakathā …) ≠ A III 117, 9 ( Be, Ee, Se so; Ce ābhisallekhikā; Mp III 275, 17 : ābhisallekhikā ti ativiya kilesasallekhikā, eds so ) ≠ Ud 36, 12 (Ud-a 226, 28 : ~ā ti ativiya kilesānaṃ sallekhanī, tesaṃ tanubhāvāya pahānāya yuttarūpā); It-a II 91, 2 (~āya kathāya lābhī eva hi taṃ bhāseyya); — abhisallekhikā in Ee at Ud-a 221, 20 is prob. wr for abhisallekhatā qv sv abhisallekha .
CPD: [ abhi-sallekhika ( prob. w. r. for ~itā, or ~atā), f. abstr. ( cf. prec. ); Ud-a 221, 20 (kalyāṇamittatā sīla- saṃvaro +)].
ābhisallekhika , the correct form for abhi° ( q. v. ).
NCP: mfn. concerned with austerity, with strict abstinence See also: ābhisallekhika
